t: This 5-litre container of Brenner Patio Cleaner is a liquid concentrate designed to clean hard outdoor surfaces. This product quickly lifts dirt, oil and outdoor grime from stone, concrete and brick. It is ideal for landscapers and groundworkers maintaining paths, patios and driveways. Formulated for use with pressure washers, this patio cleaner makes light work of regular outdoor maintenance.
b: Ideal for Maintaining Paths, Patios & Driveways
